$comment: Project settings, tracked in git on purpose (see .gitignore).
PreToolUse guard: every Bash command is read before it runs, and the ones that
destroy something on GitHub are refused. See .claude/hooks/guard-destructive.py
for what is refused and why, and .claude/hooks/test-guard-destructive.py for the
cases that prove it. Run the tests after editing the guard:
This is an accident guard, not a sandbox. The airtight control is the token scope:
a GitHub token issued WITHOUT delete_repo cannot delete a repository at all.
